version.description: The version of this file format

events.description: Eclipses and other events of the sun or the moon

body.description: Which body the event happens to: sun or moon

startDay.description: The day of the game on which it starts, counted from 0

startHour.description: The hour of that day at which it starts, 0 to 24

lengthHours.description: How long the event lasts, in game hours

depth.description: How much of the light is lost at the darkest moment, 0 to 1
